name: LUNA
description: The LUNA Surgical System is a digital robotic platform developed by Asensus Surgical for minimally invasive laparoscopic procedures. Designed around an open surgeon console and articulating 5 mm TrueWrist instruments, the system was engineered to integrate with the Intelligent Surgical Unit (ISU) for real-time digital image analytics. Standalone hardware development of the LUNA platform was discontinued following the acquisition of Asensus Surgical by KARL STORZ in 2024.

lifecycle.note: Hardware development discontinued by KARL STORZ following the acquisition of Asensus Surgical in August 2024.
